Hi Samira / Alex,

Thanks again for the time this morning — appreciate the thoughtful questions about security and data handling. Per our call, I'm kickstarting the SIG/CAIQ-style questionnaire so your security team can evaluate Redwood for the Lyra integration.

Quick recap and next steps:

- Could you confirm the preferred format (SIG spreadsheet vs your custom vendor form)? We can fill either but want to send the right file first.
- We noted Lyra's questions around HIPAA applicability and data residency — can you confirm whether PHI will be processed in scope for this integration? That will determine whether we need to surface our BAA/controls in more detail.
- Target turnaround: if possible, aim for answers back by Oct 12 so we can align procurement timelines. If you need a longer window, let me know.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_template.xlsx (SIG export), redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_202706.pdf (summary)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@lyrahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lyrahealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Lyra Health (post-call recap)

Thanks Camila — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our security team before you fill anything out:

1) SOC 2: Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report from the past 12 months (not just a summary)? If so, can you share the report via a secure link?
2) Data types: For this integration, Lyra will send de-identified user profile data and (potentially) clinical notes. Clinical notes may be considered PHI. Do you support a BAA and have you executed BAAs with other customers who process PHI?
3) Encryption: Can you confirm encryption at rest and in transit (algorithms / TLS version)? Also where are keys managed (customer KMS vs Redwood-managed)?
4) Access controls: Who at Redwood has admin access to production environments? Is there role-based access and just-in-time access?

Also — our procurement team prefers the SIG spreadsheet if you can provide that pre-filled. If you instead want to send your standard security package first, that's fine too.

Goal: procurement would like something back in ~7 business days. If you can't meet that, please let us know the earliest date.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Technical Program Manager, Security
Lyra Health
samira.khan@lyrahealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@lyrahealth.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lyrahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Lyra Health (post-call recap)

Hi Samira — great questions. Short answers below and attaching the items you requested. I've copied Marissa (Head of Platform Security) to handle the SOC 2 and technical control follow-ups.

1) SOC 2: We have a full SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2026-07 through 2027-06. For confidentiality we share full reports via secure link — attaching a summary PDF now and will provide the secure download URL to your team.
2) BAA / PHI: Redwood supports BAAs and has executed them with several customers who process PHI. If you confirm clinical notes will be in scope, we will route a standard BAA and can start the DocuSign process.
3) Encryption: TLS 1.2+ (recommend TLS 1.3); in transit via TLS, at-rest encryption with AES-256. Customers may integrate with their own KMS (customer-managed keys) for private deployments; for hosted customers we support Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed key storage.
4) Access controls: Role-based access controls (RBAC) in place; production admin access limited to SRE and Security Ops on a need-to-know basis, with JIT approval flows for privileged actions and full audit logging.

Attachments included: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_202706.pdf, redwood_SIG_template.xlsx (pre-filled core sections).

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa will review the SIG spreadsheet and fill the technical detail sections;
- We can provide the secure SOC 2 report link and a dedicated SecureShare for Lyra to download artifacts;
- If PHI is in scope, we can send the BAA via DocuSign as soon as Lyra confirms.

Marissa — can you confirm an ETA for completing the SIG spreadsheet and sending the secure SOC 2 link? Samira, let us know what deadline you prefer (Oct 12 was mentioned).

Thanks,
Camila
